description: This file defines the PasswordEnforceException class in the OrangeHRM authentication plugin, handling password enforcement exceptions and providing redirection logic.

classes.name: PasswordEnforceException
classes.description: Defines an exception for password enforcement issues, with the ability to generate a reset code and provide a redirect URL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a name and message.

methods.name: generateResetCode
methods.description: Generates a reset code by logging a password enforcement request via the password strength service.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to redirect users to for changing a weak password, including the reset code.
